name: Vanderbilt Summer Academy (VSA)
what_you_do: Spend a week on Vanderbilt's campus. Take 1 college style class and join dorm life activities. Students live on campus.
pay_detail: One-week tuition on the PTY page: $2,150 (grades 7 to 8), $2,850 (grades 9 to 10), $2,950 (grades 11 to 12). Tuition covers course, materials, housing and meals. $50 application fee ($100 international).
duration: One week. The tuition page lists several 2027 session dates in June and July.
deadline_text: The page lists 2027 session dates in June and July, and admission notices in a priority window of Jan 29 to Feb 16 (2026 dates). The application deadline for 2027 is not clearly posted.
how_to_apply: Submit the online application with the $50 fee. If you are placed in a course you pay a 20% deposit one week after the admission notice. Check the box for aid if you want to apply for it.
notes: It costs money. The page offers aid for families with adjusted gross income of $105,000 or less or severe hardship. It offers a payment plan for everyone. The page mixes 2026 deadlines with 2027 session dates. Confirm both with precollege@vanderbilt.edu.
